name: Project Integration Management
excerpt: Project Integration Management coordinates all project knowledge areas throughout a project's lifespan.
notes:
Project Integration Management is a knowledge area that involves coordinating all the project knowledge areas throughout a project’s lifespan. It ensures that various elements of the project are properly aligned and integrated.

The most important output of a project is its deliverables, highlighting the role of Project Integration Management in ensuring these are achieved.
context_summary:
- Coordinates all project knowledge areas.
- Ensures alignment and integration throughout the project lifespan.
- Focuses on achieving project deliverables.
